rules: No imitar artistas, franquicias ni estilos protegidos concretos.
Un único sujeto reconocible, composición centrada, sin texto ni bordes de carta.
Los marcos, rarezas, nombre y efectos se construyen en HTML/CSS, nunca dentro de la imagen.
Los reversos de carta se crean en SVG (CardBack), nunca con IA.

style.base: Stylized collectible card illustration, digital painting. {subject}. Centered single subject, high contrast, soft volumetric lighting, cinematic rim light, simple dark atmospheric background in {palette}, clean silhouette readable at small size, premium game art quality, square 1:1 composition. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logo, no watermark, no card border, no frame, no UI elements.
style.negative: text, letters, numbers, logo, watermark, UI, card border, frame, collage, blurry subject, low contrast, duplicate objects, cropped subject, multiple subjects, busy background
